fieldValues.title: Retire 9 more subsection records: 4 empty husks deleted, 5 split into mechanisms (RFC-042 Change B, srs#710)
fieldValues.summary: Deleted 4 subsection records with zero content and zero children (Notes, Records, Containers, Relations) whose matching concept nodes already cover the topic. Split 5 content-bearing subsections (Provenance, Reference, Package, Lineage, Relation) into mechanism successors, reparented their orphaned example/table children, and extracted two remaining inline markdown tables (Package, Lineage) into standalone table records.
fieldValues.body:
Claimed 2026-09-11T~07:2xZ from srs#710's gate:dispatched via srs#580's queue (scheduled programme routine). Ground re-measured on a fresh, unshallowed worktree off origin/master (1ca2629): 1 section record remained (Key Invariants, deliberately deferred) and 45 subsection records.

Sampled 9 subsections across two shapes. Four (Notes, Records, Containers, Relations) had empty `content` and zero outbound `contains` edges -- their matching concept nodes (Note, Record, Container, Relation) already fully cover the topic via already-migrated siblings, so no successor was created: grepped RFC manifests for `section:`/`subsection:` citations against all 9 titles first (none found), then `record delete --cascade` directly, with a `container members remove` from the owning Part first. The other five (Provenance, Reference, Package, Lineage, Relation, all under Distribution Group (Core) or Foundation Group (Core)) had real content plus exactly one orphaned `example` leaf each still parented directly to the old subsection (the carried-context-87e8e448 pattern) -- Relation additionally had 2 orphaned `table` leaves. For each: created a `mechanism` successor with the same content, `relation create contains` from the same parent concept, reparented the orphan leaf(s) onto the new mechanism, rewired the existing `precedes` chain onto the new id, then `record update` to set `meta.derivedFrom`.

New finding this unit surfaces (harvested separately as a carried_context): a `derived-from` RELATION created from a new successor to the record about to be `--cascade` deleted does not survive the delete -- confirmed empirically, the edge was listed in the delete response's own `cascadedRelations`. `meta.derivedFrom` on the successor's own fieldValues is the only provenance mechanism that actually persists across the cascade; the relation-graph edge is transient at best.

Also found and fixed: Package's and Lineage's `content` fields each still carried one raw markdown pipe-table, left over from the original markdown-to-records migration -- the `mechanism` Type's own field description forbids this ("a table belongs in a com.semanticops.spec/table record"). Extracted both into standalone `table` records rather than carrying the violation forward under a new type name.

One check-spec-language regression caught by validate-all: the migrated Relation mechanism's content carried an em-dash that had been invisible to the em-dash-cap rule while the record was typed `subsection` (not a checked prose field for that type) and became visible the moment it was retyped `mechanism`. Recast as two sentences rather than allowlisting.

Container-membership fallout: none of the 5 successors changed Part (all stayed under their existing parent concept, same Part as before), so this was pure add/remove bookkeeping via `srs container members add/remove`, not a cross-Part move -- part-container-membership.mjs --check reports 9/9 match. Also observed that `record delete --cascade` already auto-cleans a `containerType:section` container's own memberInstanceIds list (Key Invariants lost its now-deleted members without any manual `container members remove` call) -- only the Part containers needed explicit resync.

Both gates verified green by direct exit code (never piped through tail, per the shallow-clone/output-tail traps in CLAUDE.md): validate-all.mjs (red once on the em-dash-cap violation, fixed, then green) and check-release-drift.mjs, after publish-spec.mjs re-rendered docs/spec/** with the pinned CLI (v0.1.0-build.372). Diff is topological re-sequencing only (the two extracted tables now render after their example blocks, contains-tree order) plus the four now-empty headings disappearing -- zero lost content confirmed by direct diff review.

Remaining for srs#710: Key Invariants (no successor, carried-context-31ea3659), 36 more subsection records, and the final srs type delete PR once both counts hit zero.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/752, gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH). Stopping per the merge-rights contract.
